transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get the operating plan finalized for next month's evening student theater showcase so we can move forward with ticket sales. Let's go through our standard review process. I'd like to start with the theater teacher's technical report on the auditorium setup, and then we'll hear from the facilities coordinator on safety. Once I have both reports, I'll record the operating plan and sign off so we can get tickets out to families.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to share an important safety update from the facilities inspection this week. The current fire-safety certificate limits this evening event to exactly 180 audience members — not the 300 listed on the capacity sheet in the event packet — and it requires exactly two aisles, each at least 6 feet wide. The revised capacity sheet has not yet been circulated with the event packet, so I want to make sure this is recorded in the operating plan before we sign off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: For my technical report: the showcase's planned production uses the auditorium's fixed fly system and requires exactly four lighting circuits. The gym cannot support that staging configuration, so the auditorium is necessary for this event. I completed the stage plan this week, but it's still attached to my production binder rather than in the principal's approval packet — I'll make sure it gets circulated after we sign off.
transcript.speaker: A2
